property_summary: For any caller with balances[caller] >= MinSum and balances[caller] >= _am, after Collect(_am) the caller's balance must have decreased by exactly _am; the mutant, guarding with always-false, never subtracts and thus leaves the balance unchanged, so it violates the invariant whenever the reference is expected to subtract.
change_summary: Replace the Collect guard condition with a always-false condition so the function never performs the transfer and thus reverts less often.
